Game Overview

In B.I.T, the core idea is straightforward: quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of B.I.T follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is B.I.T?

B.I.T is a free robots game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is B.I.T free to play?

Yes, B.I.T is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
